propositions: Project routing overlay cannot currently extend built-in overlay triggers; it can only define standalone project.* criteria.
The mechanism must allow projects to add trigger_tokens (literal substrings) and applies_to globs to a built-in overlay id without replacing the committed globs.
Project trigger extensions must be read directly from the raw code_review entries rather than through effective_routing to preserve union semantics instead of replace semantics.
Both glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays must consume the project trigger extensions by unioning them with committed triggers, with repo_root threaded from overlay_union call site.
Malformed project entries (non-list trigger_tokens, non-string tokens, unknown overlay ids) must be silently ignored without raising exceptions.
